query:
WITH '<namespace_here>' as namespace
MATCH p = (n:Namespace)-[:Ingress]->(f)
WHERE n.displayname = namespace
  AND NOT (f)-[:ToPorts]->(:Port)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium Namespace - Ingress To Any Port (Direct)
description: Direct ingress (i.e., no endpoint selectors) to any TCP/UDP port for a specific namespace
